data.name: Kopitiam King
data.detailed_description:
Kopitiam King is a fast-paced management game set in a nostalgic kopitiam. Serve classic kopi and roti orders under pressure, manage a struggling family business, and keep your customers happy as chaos unfolds in the kitchen.

With only one kopitiam left in the world, it’s up to you to save the kopitiam culture from becoming a distant memory!

KOPITIAM CULTURE

A kopitiam (traditional coffee shop) is not just a place to enjoy a meal, it is also a place for people from all walks of life to come together. You’ll experience the sights, sounds, and pace of a bustling kopitiam, from morning kopi rushes to demanding regulars who know exactly how they like their orders.

FAST-PACED GAMEPLAY: PAO KOPI, PENG ROTI

Prepare and serve a variety of kopi (coffee) and roti (bread) by following customer orders precisely.

  • Brew different styles of kopi using traditional methods

  • Toast, butter, and serve roti exactly to customer preferences

  • Plate and deliver before customer patience runs out

Managing the kopitiam becomes increasingly challenging as positive reviews draw larger and more demanding crowds!

FROM ‘TOWKAY KIA’ TO ‘TUA TOWKAY’

Your father’s failing health means the kopitiam’s future now rests on you.

  • Progress through days and stages as the business grows

  • Learn to manage orders, efficiency, and customer satisfaction

  • Make strategic investments to keep up with the times

Can you handle the heat, satisfy every order, and keep the last kopitiam alive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel 11th Gen i5 or AMD Ryzen 5000 Series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 30 series or AMD Radeon RX 6000 series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Sound Card: Any
